h1:
Where to Stay in Surat Thani?
12 Stays We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Twelve Surat Thani stays across every budget — 5-star private pool villas on Koh Samui's beaches down to a town hostel from ฿350. Covering the destinations travellers actually use: Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, the Khao Sok-Cheow Lan lake and Surat Thani town. Starting from around ฿350–18,000/night.
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right base in Surat Thani matter so much?
introHtml: Surat Thani is far more than its town — it's the gateway to islands and nature that feel worlds apart, so matching your stay to where you actually want to explore matters more than the hotel itself. Koh Samui is white-sand beaches, luxury resorts and nightlife around Chaweng-Lamai-Bophut · Koh Phangan is quieter, with beautiful beaches and the Full Moon Party · Koh Tao is a diver's paradise · Khao Sok-Cheow Lan is an emerald lake inside the national park where you sleep on floating rafts · and Surat Thani town is the staging point before the ferry crossings. Many travellers book without realising their hotel is on a different island or coast, then burn whole days on boats and minivans. This guide brings together 12 Surat Thani stays we've reviewed across every tier — every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Surat Thani has no metro — the main ways to get around are by plane, boat and road. Koh Samui has its own airport (USM) for the easiest access, or take the ferry from Don Sak pier. Koh Phangan and Koh Tao are reached by onward boat from Samui or the mainland piers. Khao Sok-Cheow Lan is about a 2-hour drive from town, then a boat into the lake. The main destinations in this guide: Koh Samui — Banyan Tree (Lamai Bay), Anantara Bophut, SALA Samui and Anantara Lawana (Chaweng), Samui Resotel · Koh Phangan — Amara Beach Resort (Haad Yao) · Koh Tao — Jamahkiri Resort (Thian Og Bay) · Khao Sok-Cheow Lan — 500 Rai Floating Resort and Khao Sok Rafthouse (floating rafts on the lake) · Town — Diamond Plaza, Wangtai, 2street Hostel, the staging point before island crossings.

entries.name: Banyan Tree Samui
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Lamai Bay·Maret · Koh Samui · private beach
tags: 🏊 Every villa has a private infinity pool
entries.addr: 99/9 Moo 4, Maret, Lamai Bay, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: The top score in this guide at 9.5 — Banyan Tree Samui is Koh Samui's top-tier pool villa resort, where every villa has its own private infinity pool with sea views, set on a hillside above Lamai Bay. Real reviews praise the high level of privacy, the warm service (a buggy arrives within 4–5 minutes), and the Banyan Tree Spa with its Rainforest hydrotherapy and skilled therapists. It suits couples, honeymooners and special-occasion trips that want the very best of Samui.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The resort is built on a steep hillside and you'll rely on the buggy throughout — if walking is tricky, ask for a villa near the central areas. Upgrade to an Ocean View Pool Villa if the budget allows; the full sea view is worth it.
pros: Every villa has a private infinity pool with sea views, high privacy
Warm, attentive service; buggy usually arrives within 4–5 minutes
Quiet private beach with free water-sports equipment
Banyan Tree Spa with skilled therapists, praised in reviews
cons: The most expensive in this guide — best for special occasions
Steep hillside, you depend on buggies · rocks exposed at low tide

entries.name: Anantara Bophut Koh Samui Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bophut beach · 5-min walk to Fisherman's Village
entries.addr: 99/9 Moo 1, Bophut Bay, Bophut beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Anantara Bophut is a luxury resort on Bophut beach, quieter than Chaweng yet a 5-minute walk to Fisherman's Village, scoring 9.2 from 633 reviews. Reviewers highlight the shaded tropical garden and private feel, the attentive Anantara service where staff remember guests, and the garden spa and beachfront pool. You can stroll out to Fisherman's Village for dinner, and the Samui airport is about 10 minutes away — ideal if you want a luxury resort that still lets you walk into a dining and nightlife area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The entry-level Deluxe is a garden view with no sea outlook; upgrade to Premier Sea View if you want the bay. In the evening, walk over to Fisherman's Village for a seaside dinner.
pros: Lush, shaded tropical garden with a private, quiet atmosphere
5-minute walk to Fisherman's Village for easy dinners out
Attentive Anantara service, staff remember guests
About 10 minutes from Samui airport · garden spa and beachfront pool
cons: Some entry-level rooms are garden view with no sea outlook
Food and drink prices inside the resort run high

entries.name: SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort
entries.revCount: 1,715 reviews · most reviewed in this guide
entries.addr: 99/10 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Chaweng beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: SALA Samui is the most reviewed stay in this guide — over 1,715 reviews, and still scoring 9.1, which reflects a consistency that's hard to find. Reviewers love the sharp black-and-white minimalist design that's photogenic from every angle, the warm service where the manager personally looks after guests, and beachfront pool villas at a more attainable price than many luxury resorts. It sits right on Chaweng beach and is only ~15 minutes from the airport for easy arrivals and departures.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Garden Wing is across the road from the beach, so you cross back and forth; choose the Oceanfront Wing if you want to be beachside. Villa private pools aren't heated, so the water gets cool in the evening.
pros: Most reviewed in this guide, 1,715 reviews, consistent 9.1 score
Crisp black-and-white minimalist design, photogenic everywhere
Beachfront pool villas at a more attainable price than many luxury resorts
Warm staff, free kayaks and paddleboards
cons: Garden Wing is across the road from the beach, you cross back and forth
Food and room-service prices run high

entries.name: Anantara Lawana Koh Samui Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 North end of Chaweng beach · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 92/1 Moo 2, Bophut, north Chaweng beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Anantara Lawana is a luxury resort on the quieter north end of Chaweng, with rooms and common areas freshly renovated in late 2024, scoring 9.1 from 747 reviews. The draw is a beach-end location that's calm but still walkable to dining, a pretty beachfront pool with private beach access, and Anantara touches like the rooftop Muay Thai ring. The Samui airport is only about 11 minutes away — ideal if you want Anantara luxury on a part of Chaweng that isn't too hectic.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Some entry-level rooms are garden view; upgrade to a Lawana Pool Suite for a private plunge pool. The grounds are on a slope with several flights of steps, and the garden has mosquitoes in the evening — bring repellent.
pros: Rooms and common areas freshly renovated in late 2024
Quieter north end of Chaweng, but still walkable to dining
Pretty beachfront pool with private beach access
About 11 minutes from Samui airport · novel Anantara activities
cons: Some entry-level rooms are garden view with no sea outlook
Sloped grounds with several flights of steps · evening mosquitoes in the garden

entries.name: Diamond Plaza Hotel Suratthani
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Si Wichai Rd · walk to Central Plaza
entries.addr: 83/27 Si Wichai Rd, Makham Tia, Surat Thani town
entries.storyHtml: Diamond Plaza is the best-value option in Surat Thani town, scoring 9.0 from 146 reviews from just ฿700. Real reviews say the rooms are cleaner than the building's exterior suggests, with comfortable beds, strong hot water and Wi-Fi fast enough to stream. The standouts are a large pool with a separate kids' pool, free parking, and staff who help book ferry tickets and transfers; it's walkable to Central Plaza and Lotus. Ideal as a great-value staging point before crossing to Koh Samui or Koh Phangan.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Walls are fairly thin and you can hear neighbours — ask for an interior room away from the street for quiet. Booking ferry tickets through the hotel desk is easier than arranging them yourself.
pros: Central location, walk to Central Plaza and Lotus
Clean rooms, comfortable beds, strong hot water, fast Wi-Fi
Large pool with a separate kids' pool · spacious free parking
From ฿700, excellent value · helps with ferry tickets and transfers
cons: Building and decor are dated, not a new design hotel
Thin walls, you hear neighbours · the area is quiet at night

entries.name: 500 Rai Khao Sok Floating Resort
entries.revCount: 62 reviews · Agoda 8.8 · floating raft on the lake
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Middle of Cheow Lan Lake · Khao Sok National Park
tags: 🛶 Kayak and spot wildlife from your room
entries.addr: 21/5 Moo 3, Khao Wong, Ban Ta Khun (Cheow Lan Lake, Khao Sok National Park)
entries.storyHtml: 500 Rai Floating Resort is a luxe floating-raft experience on Cheow Lan Lake that's unlike anywhere else in Thailand, scoring 8.8. Real reviews say the lake and limestone-peak views are scenery you simply can't find elsewhere, the atmosphere is peacefully off-grid, and you can swim, kayak and watch wildlife straight from your room — sometimes spotting monkeys, hornbills and even elephants by the water. The warm timber rooms have balconies that hang over the lake, ideal for couples and anyone who genuinely wants to switch off.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There's no Wi-Fi or phone signal and the air-con only runs at night, so come prepared to disconnect, and stay at least 2 nights to make it worthwhile. Drinks and extra food ordered on-site cost more than usual.
pros: Lake and limestone-peak views you can't find elsewhere
Peacefully off-grid, ideal for switching off
Swim, kayak and watch wildlife straight from your room
Warm timber rooms with private balconies over the water
cons: No Wi-Fi or phone signal · air-con runs only at night
Rooms and activities are pricey, everything is an extra charge

entries.name: Jamahkiri Resort & Spa
entries.badge: 🐠 Snorkelling off the beach, Koh Tao
tags: 🚐 Shuttle up and down the cliff
entries.addr: 21/2 Moo 3, Thian Og Bay, Koh Tao
entries.storyHtml: Jamahkiri is a cliffside resort above Thian Og Bay on Koh Tao with ornate carved Thai architecture you won't see anywhere else, and a hefty 1,415 reviews, scoring 8.5. Reviewers single out the clear Thian Og Bay views from the rooms and spa where you can see coral, the private beach below that's a great snorkelling spot, and the Thai-motif character that's photogenic from every angle. It's a quiet resort set apart from busy Sairee — ideal for divers and anyone wanting a distinctive stay on Koh Tao.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The resort is built on a cliff with lots of stairs up and down — not ideal for bad knees, though there's a shuttle. On-site dining options are limited and pricey, so plan to head down into the island for some meals.
pros: Ornate carved Thai architecture, unlike anywhere on Koh Tao
Snorkel straight off the beach with plenty of fish and coral
Beautiful, clear Thian Og Bay views from rooms and spa
Quiet and set apart · shuttle up and down the cliff
cons: Cliffside with lots of stairs, not ideal for bad knees
Limited on-site dining, pricier than island restaurants

entries.name: Samui Resotel Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 South end of Chaweng beach · Koh Samui
entries.addr: 17 Moo 3, Chaweng Beach, Bo Phut, south Chaweng, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Samui Resotel is a beachfront resort on the quieter, clearer south end of Chaweng, at a price that's attainable for a beachfront stay on Samui, scoring 8.6. Real reviews say it's right on real white sand, the rooms are larger than expected for the price (especially after the 2023 renovation), and the staff are friendly and helpful. It's close to the Samui airport, runs a free shuttle to Central, and has strong Wi-Fi throughout — ideal if you want a beachfront Samui stay without paying 5-star rates.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Soundproofing between villas isn't great, so ask for a room not next to a walkway or empty unit for quiet. The bar closes around 9pm, so head out if you want a late night.
pros: Right on real white sand, on the quieter, clearer south end of Chaweng
Rooms larger than expected for the price, especially after the 2023 renovation
Attainable price for a beachfront resort on Koh Samui
Close to the airport, free shuttle to Central · strong Wi-Fi
cons: Parts of the resort are showing their age and need refreshing
Soundproofing between villas isn't great · bar closes early

entries.name: 2street Hostel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bandon Rd · 4-min walk to the night market
entries.addr: 61 Bandon Road, Tambon Talat, Surat Thani town
entries.storyHtml: 2street Hostel is the highest-scoring stay in the budget tier — 8.9 from 290 reviews, from just ฿350 a bed. Real reviews say the owner (Khun Su) looks after guests personally and is so friendly it feels like home, with comfortable beds and thick mattresses that many call the best they've slept on in Thailand. The location is excellent — a 4-minute walk to the night market and close to the island ferry piers — with a free airport shuttle and help booking ferry tickets. Ideal for solo travellers and couples passing through before crossing to the islands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The air-con pauses roughly 12:00–15:00 daily, so it can get warm in the afternoon — plan to be out exploring then. It's adults only, so not suitable for families with children.
pros: Owner looks after guests personally, very friendly, feels like home
Comfortable beds, thick mattresses many call the best they've slept on
Excellent location, 4-min walk to the night market, near island piers
Free airport shuttle · helps book tours and ferry tickets
cons: Air-con pauses roughly 12:00–15:00 daily, can be warm in the afternoon
Adults only, not for families · some rooms small and dim

entries.name: Khao Sok Rafthouse
entries.badge: 🪙 Raft stay at an attainable price
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Middle of Cheow Lan Lake · Khao Sok National Park
tags: 🛶 Sleep on the lake on a budget
🎒 Great for backpackers and budget families
entries.addr: 6/2 Moo 1, Khao Phang, Ban Ta Khun (Cheow Lan Lake, Khao Sok National Park)
entries.storyHtml: Khao Sok Rafthouse is the budget way to sleep on a floating raft in the middle of Cheow Lan Lake, from ฿1,800, scoring 8.6 — much the same experience as the luxury resorts at a far lighter cost. Real reviews say the limestone-peak and emerald-water views are scenery you can't find elsewhere, the fresh southern Thai food is better than expected for somewhere this remote, and you can jump in and kayak straight off the raft. Packages bundle boat, food and activities to keep the budget simple — ideal for backpackers and budget families.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Facilities are basic — some raft types have shared bathrooms and no hot water, so check the raft type before booking. Power runs only at certain hours and there's barely any signal or Wi-Fi, so bring a torch and cash.
pros: Sleep in the middle of Cheow Lan Lake at an attainable price
Limestone-peak and emerald-water views you can't find elsewhere
Fresh, tasty southern Thai food · packages bundle boat, food and activities
Jump in, kayak and enjoy nature straight from the raft
cons: Basic facilities, some raft types have shared bathrooms and no hot water
Power runs only at certain hours · barely any signal or Wi-Fi

entries.name: Amara Beach Resort Koh Phangan
entries.revCount: Booking 8.5 · opened 2022 · Haad Yao, Koh Phangan
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Haad Yao · west coast · Koh Phangan
tags: 🏖️ On Haad Yao, a minute to the sand
entries.storyHtml: Amara Beach Resort is a new beachfront resort on Haad Yao on Koh Phangan, opened in 2022 and excellent value from ฿1,300, scoring 8.4. Real reviews say it's genuinely on Haad Yao — a minute's walk to the sand on a pretty, quiet beach — with very friendly staff who remember guests, and rooms larger than expected with comfortable beds. There's a beachfront pool and fresh breakfast that's better than expected for a small property. Ideal if you want a quiet Phangan beach stay without paying a premium.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's a fair way from Thong Sala pier, so you'll want to rent a scooter or arrange transport — plan your island travel. Connecting-room doors aren't well soundproofed and some nights there's noise from a neighbouring venue, so ask for a room away from the restaurant.
pros: Genuinely on Haad Yao, a minute to the sand, pretty and quiet
New resort, opened 2022, still in good condition and clean
Rooms larger than expected, comfortable beds, at an attainable price
Beachfront pool · fresh breakfast better than expected
cons: A fair way from Thong Sala pier, you'll need transport
Connecting-room doors aren't well soundproofed · few facilities, no spa/gym

entries.name: Wangtai Hotel
entries.revCount: 68 reviews · Agoda 8.0 · on the Tapi River
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Talad Mai Rd · on the Tapi River · town
entries.addr: 1 Talad Mai Road, Tambon Talat, Surat Thani town
entries.storyHtml: Wangtai Hotel is a town hotel on the Tapi River that makes a handy staging point before crossing to Koh Samui or Koh Phangan, from ฿900, scoring 8.0. Real reviews say the rooms are cleaner than the exterior suggests, and the river-view rooms over the Tapi are lovely, looking out to the river and suspension bridge. The draws are a large pool with a kids' pool, friendly staff who help with ferry tickets and transfers, free parking and an airport shuttle. Ideal if you want a well-equipped town base before the boat to the islands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The building and decor are dated and rooms vary, so ask for a renovated river-view room for the best view and condition. The town is quiet at night, so plan an early dinner.
pros: Rooms cleaner than the exterior suggests
River-view rooms over the Tapi, with the river and suspension bridge
Large, clean pool with a separate kids' pool
Handy staging point before the islands · free parking + airport shuttle
cons: Building and decor are dated, rooms vary in condition
Surat Thani town is quiet at night, not a busy tourist hub

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Surat Thani stay for you?

advice.head: Tight budget, want the best value
advice.bodyHtml: → 2street Hostel from ฿350/bed in town, scoring 8.9 · or Diamond Plaza ฿700, a town hotel with a pool, best value before crossing to the islands

advice.head: Special trip, luxury pool villas
advice.bodyHtml: → Banyan Tree Samui ฿18,000, every villa has a private infinity pool, scoring 9.5 · or Anantara Bophut ฿6,500, a luxury resort on Bophut beach

advice.head: Want a beachfront stay on Koh Samui
advice.bodyHtml: → SALA Samui Chaweng ฿7,500, beachfront pool villas, most reviewed · or Samui Resotel ฿3,200, beachfront at an attainable price

advice.head: Want to sleep on the Khao Sok lake
advice.bodyHtml: → 500 Rai Floating Resort ฿11,000, a luxe floating raft with limestone-peak views · or Khao Sok Rafthouse ฿1,800, a raft stay on a budget

advice.head: Diver, heading to Koh Tao
advice.bodyHtml: → Jamahkiri Resort & Spa ฿5,500, a cliffside resort above Thian Og Bay, snorkel off the beach, ornate carved Thai architecture

advice.head: Want a quiet beach on Koh Phangan
advice.bodyHtml: → Amara Beach Resort Koh Phangan ฿1,300, on Haad Yao, a new 2022 resort with great value and a pretty, quiet beach

advice.head: Just a stopover before the ferry
advice.bodyHtml: → Wangtai Hotel ฿900 on the Tapi River, near transfers to the piers · or Diamond Plaza ฿700, helps book ferry tickets and transfers

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Surat Thani stays

faq.q: ❓ Where should tourists stay in Surat Thani?
faq.a: It depends on your destination. Koh Samui suits beach lovers wanting luxury resorts and nightlife (Banyan Tree, Anantara Bophut, SALA Samui, Anantara Lawana, Samui Resotel) · Koh Phangan is for quiet beaches and the Full Moon Party (Amara Beach Resort) · Koh Tao is for divers (Jamahkiri) · Khao Sok-Cheow Lan is for nature lovers sleeping on floating rafts (500 Rai, Khao Sok Rafthouse) · and the town is best as a stopover before crossing to the islands (Diamond Plaza, Wangtai, 2street Hostel).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Surat Thani stays cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and budget rafts start around ฿350–1,800 · town 3-star hotels around ฿700–1,000 a night · 4-star beachfront resorts around ฿1,300–3,200 · pool villas and 5-star luxury on Koh Samui from around ฿5,500–18,000+. During high season (Dec–Feb) and festivals, island prices can be well above normal.

faq.q: ❓ How do Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao differ?
faq.a: Koh Samui is the largest, with its own airport, the Chaweng-Lamai-Bophut beaches, luxury resorts and full facilities · Koh Phangan is quieter with natural beaches and the Full Moon Party at Haad Rin · Koh Tao is the smallest and a diver's paradise with clear water and beautiful coral · all three are connected by boat, so with a few days you can island-hop.

faq.q: ❓ What's it like sleeping on a Khao Sok-Cheow Lan floating raft, and how many nights?
faq.a: Sleeping on a floating raft in the middle of Cheow Lan Lake is a one-of-a-kind experience, with stunning limestone-peak and emerald-water views, and you can swim, kayak and watch wildlife straight from the raft. But most rafts have no Wi-Fi, no phone signal, and air-con that runs only at night. We'd suggest at least 2 nights to make the journey worthwhile — it's about a 2-hour drive from town plus a boat.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Surat Thani stay?
faq.a: On weekdays outside peak season, 2–4 weeks ahead is enough. But during high season (Dec–Feb), Songkran, New Year and Full Moon Party nights on Koh Phangan, the good island stays fill up fast, so book 1–2 months ahead — especially for pool villas and the Khao Sok rafts, which have limited rooms.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Surat Thani stays?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion at any given time, so we'd suggest comparing all 3 before every booking — each review page in this guide has comparison links so you can save hundreds of baht per night.
